sports.headline: Manchester United sack Michael Carrick and agree deal with USA coach Mauricio Pochettino
sports.summary: United sacked Carrick on Thursday after their worst-ever start to a Premier League season, with the club in the relegation zone. They have agreed a two-and-a-half-year deal with Pochettino, which runs to summer 2029. Reports say United will pay a buyout of about $10m to release him from his USA contract. A formal announcement is expected Friday. He is set to be United's eighth permanent appointment since Sir Alex Ferguson retired.

sports.headline: Mirra Andreeva routs Aryna Sabalenka at the WTA Finals to reach the semi-finals
sports.summary: French Open champion Andreeva beat world number two Sabalenka 6-4, 6-0, winning 11 straight games, and topped Group 2 on her WTA Finals debut. Sabalenka now needs to beat Elina Svitolina on Friday to reach the last four. Reports say the result puts Andreeva close to a new ranking milestone.

sports.headline: Inaugural Swim GP launches in Melbourne, billed as the 'F1 of swimming'
sports.summary: Four teams of 20 swimmers (Kraken, Wahoo, KingTide and Tsunami) race for points over two nights, 13–14 November, in a 25m pool with no times recorded. The made-for-TV format adds fan voting, bonus points and 'coaches calls'. Kyle Chalmers and Mollie O'Callaghan have withdrawn through injury and illness, while Kaylee McKeown returns.

sports.headline: Otro Capital hires bank to explore sale of its Alpine F1 stake
sports.summary: Investment firm Otro Capital has hired BDT & MSD Partners to explore selling its minority stake in the Alpine Formula 1 team, according to Sportico, which cites four people familiar with the matter. The move shows continued investor activity in F1 team valuations.

fashion.headline: Capri Holdings names Estée Lauder veteran Justin Boxford CEO as John Idol retires
fashion.summary: Boxford, most recently global president of Estée Lauder's luxury beauty brands, becomes CEO of the Michael Kors and Jimmy Choo owner on 4 January 2027. He succeeds John Idol, who has led Capri since 2003 and will stay on as senior adviser until 31 March 2027. Robin Freestone becomes independent chairman. The change comes as Capri works to revive demand at Michael Kors.

marketing.headline: England Netball campaign celebrates women's participation in the history of the sport
marketing.summary: Campaign reports on a new England Netball campaign that looks back at the history of women's participation in the sport. It is a creative piece of marketing that supports women's sport. Only the Campaign homepage listing, dated 11 November 2026, was available, so the article link is the site homepage.

marketing.headline: Omnicom Media creates new brand president role for UM EMEA
marketing.summary: Campaign reports that Omnicom Media has named a brand president of UM EMEA, a new role for the agency. It is a senior agency leadership move. Only the Campaign media section listing, dated 12 November 2026, was available.
